recipes.name: Crispy-Skin Barramundi
recipes.subtitle: Brown-Rice Prawn Risotto
recipes.description: Charred corn, peas, baby spinach, heirloom tomato, lemon and basil oil.
recipes.plating_alt: Crispy-skin barramundi over prawn and brown-rice risotto, with blistered tomatoes, basil oil, micro herbs and lemon zest.
method: Season barramundi with salt and pepper.
Cook skin-side down in a hot pan with oil until crispy, then finish in the oven or flip to cook through. Rest.
In a pan, sweat onion and garlic. Add cooked brown rice and hot stock; bring to the right consistency.
Add prawns, corn, peas and spinach. Finish with butter and Parmesan. Season to taste.
Halve and blister the cherry tomatoes.
Plate the risotto, top with barramundi skin-side up and arrange tomatoes. Finish with lemon, basil oil and micro herbs. Keep oil off the crisp skin.
key_points: Use pre-cooked brown rice to save time.
Keep the risotto glossy and loose, not dry.

recipes.name: Eye Fillet
recipes.subtitle: Caramelised-Onion Potato Croquette
recipes.description: Mushroom ragout, charred broccolini, roasted garlic-Parmesan butter and herb oil.
recipes.plating_alt: Eye fillet with garlic-Parmesan butter, a golden potato croquette, mushroom ragout, charred broccolini and herb oil.
method: Mix cold mash with egg yolk and seasoning. Form a cylinder around the caramelised-onion centre. Coat in flour, beaten egg and breadcrumbs, then chill. Fry until golden and crisp.
Cook mushrooms, shallot and garlic in butter. Add cream, thyme and seasoning. Reduce to a ragout.
Season eye fillet and sear in a hot pan to the desired doneness. Rest.
Char broccolini in a hot pan with oil and season.
Mix the roasted garlic-Parmesan butter ingredients, chill and slice a medallion.
Plate the mushroom ragout and place the steak on top with the butter. Add the croquette and broccolini. Finish with herb oil, micro herbs and jus if using.
key_points: Keep the croquette cold before frying for a crisp exterior.
Keep the caramelised onion inside the croquette.
Keep mushroom ragout rich but not too wet.
Add the butter just before serving.
